<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter as Limiter;

class RateLimiter
{
    /**
     * Sliding-window rate limit per API key — protects
     * shared endpoints from abuse without blocking normal use.
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        $key = 'api:' . $request->header('X-Api-Key', $request->ip());

        if (Limiter::tooManyAttempts($key, 60)) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'Too many requests.',
            ], 429);
        }

        Limiter::hit($key, 60);

        return $next($request);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Jobs;

use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;

class ReportJob implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable, SerializesModels;

    public int $tries = 3;
    public int $backoff = 30;

    public function __construct(private int $tenantId) {}

    /**
     * Runs off the request cycle — keeps heavy report
     * generation from ever blocking the user-facing app.
     */
    public function handle(): void
    {
        $report = Report::forTenant($this->tenantId)->build();

        $report->store()->notifyOwners();
    }
}
